description: Convert between JSON and CSV. Operations: "json-to-csv" — Convert a JSON array/object to CSV.; "csv-to-json" — Convert CSV to a JSON array.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: json-to-csv: The JSON text to convert. csv-to-json: The CSV text to convert.

operation.description: json-to-csv — Convert a JSON array/object to CSV. csv-to-json — Convert CSV to a JSON array.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

delimiter.description: Field delimiter. Used by: json-to-csv, csv-to-json.

firstRowHeaders.description: Treat the first row as headers. Used by: csv-to-json.

includeHeaders.description: Emit a header row. Used by: json-to-csv.

nestedHandling.description: How to handle nested objects. Used by: json-to-csv.

name: json-csv
title: JSON / CSV Converter
